entries.title: Two papers accepted to the AI-Native Academia workshop at NeurIPS 2026
entries.desc: “ReviewShield: Defending LLM Reviewers Against In-Paper Prompt Injection under Instruction-Content Entanglement” (Somnath Luitel, Prabhjot Singh, Suraj Thapa, Manmeet Singh, Josh Durkee) was accepted as an Oral, and “Talking a Rejection Into an Accept? Confidence Framing and the Model-Specific Style Sensitivity of LLM Reviewers” (Prabhjot Singh, Somnath Luitel, Manmeet Singh) was accepted as a Poster — both at the AI-Native Academia workshop, NeurIPS 2026.

entries.title: Dr. Manmeet Singh recognized among the World's Top 5% of Scientists
entries.desc: Dr. Manmeet Singh has been named among the world's top 5% of scientists in a global bibliometric ranking of more than 10 million researchers, reflecting his contributions to AI, atmospheric, climate, and disaster science since joining WKU's Department of Earth, Environmental & Atmospheric Sciences.

entries.title: Prabhjot Singh joins AIR Lab as External Collaborator
entries.desc: We're glad to welcome Prabhjot Singh, an AI Research Scientist and MS student in AI at UT Austin, as an external collaborator working on AI for disaster science and trustworthy AI.

entries.title: AirCast-SR presented at NSF EPSCoR SuperCollider 2026
entries.desc: Graduate researcher Somnath Luitel presented “AirCast-SR: A Foundation Model for Kilometer-Scale Atmospheric Super-Resolution via Conditional Diffusion” at the Kentucky NSF EPSCoR SuperCollider 2026 all-hands meeting in Lexington, KY.

entries.title: MSc Poster Award at Environmental Intelligence 2026
entries.desc: Graduate researcher Somnath Luitel received an MSc Poster Presentation Award at Environmental Intelligence 2026, hosted at the University of Exeter, UK.
